name: Whispering Pines
desc:
🔦 Welcome to Whispering Pines

Deep in the woods of the Virginia mountains lies Whispering Pines—a nature park shrouded in mystery. Urban legends have long warned of strange disappearances, but now the truth is emerging… The Spinewalker has been linked to countless missing persons cases, most vanishing after overnight trips.

Will you survive the night, or become the forest’s next victim?

🕹 Controls
LShift – Sprint
C – Crouch
LShift + C – Slide

⚔️ Run, hide, or fight back—it’s your choice.
🔊 Headphones recommended! Sound is your best tool—and your worst nightmare.
👥 Team up with friends or go solo for the ultimate challenge!
✨ Premium & Group Members get exclusive in-game bonuses!
🎮 Cross-platform support – Play anywhere!
